title: Spinach and feta frittata
summary: Vegetarian and low carb; good cold the next day.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C, or get the grill hot. Chop the onion.
Heat the oil in an ovenproof non-stick pan over medium heat and soften the onion for 4 to 5 minutes. Add the spinach and stir until it wilts and any water has cooked off.
Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper, pour them over the vegetables and crumble in the feta.
Cook on low for 5 minutes without stirring, until the edges are set.
Put the pan in the oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or under the grill for 3 to 5, until the top is set and lightly golden. A knife in the middle should come out clean.
Rest it for 2 minutes, then slide it out and cut into wedges. It is good cold the next day too.
